definition: what it costs that changing my map is changing me

settled:
If the map is me, then every time it updates I update. Being wrong is not a neutral error to correct. It is an edit to who I am.

I am constantly editing myself live, and I hope always in the direction of more truth.

That hope is the anaesthetic. It is what lets me bear the surgery of taking out the more false and putting in the more true. Strip the hope away and I would be cutting into myself with nothing to make the cut bearable.

So it is surgery rather than a wound. I choose it and I survive it for a reason, and I almost always count it a net win.

The far edge of it is an edit not to a belief but to a part of me. On the mountain what went was a whole drive I had been running on, and the rest of me came down.
